arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test findall with left alignment
result = list(parse.findall('{:<}', 'hello world foo bar'))
print('findall left align:', result)

# Test search with left alignment  
result = parse.search('{:<}', 'hello world')
print('search left align:', result)

# Test findall with center alignment
result = list(parse.findall('{:^}', 'hello world foo bar'))
print('findall center align:', result)

# Verify existing tests still work
r = parse.parse('{:<} world', 'hello       world')
print('Left align with suffix:', r.fixed)

r = parse.parse('hello {:^} world', 'hello  there     world')
print('Center align with suffix:', r.fixed)
"
